# FUNCTIONAL_R3_CA12

Sealed synthetic replacement holdout for the CA-12 component comparison. The
archive contains 16 files and its 10 queries/judgments; only the evaluation
steward may decrypt it with the key kept outside Git in the canonical audit
directory. The current runner must execute exactly `full`, `no_expansion`,
`no_semantic` and `no_catalog` in isolated workspaces and emit aggregate-only
results. This reserve must not be used for tuning after freeze or after any
aggregate is disclosed.
